response.sql: WITH media_rates AS (SELECT mt.Name, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS byte_rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM MediaType AS mt JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate FROM media_rates) SELECT AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.track_count) AS avg_track_count, AVG(m.byte_rate - o.avg_byte_rate) AS avg_excess_byte_rate FROM media_rates AS m CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE m.byte_rate > o.avg_byte_rate;
